subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, replace it with a narrow upstream PR, or wait for the contributor to refresh it?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-proven and small, but the active candidate is outside the target repository with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not queue duplicate work without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt Or Review The Fork PR
options.body: Review the external patch against current main and adopt it if it still fits the shared helper boundary.

options.title: Replace With A Narrow Upstream PR
options.body: Create a fresh target-repo PR that only normalizes the shared label and adds the missing regression test.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the external contributor to update the fork branch before maintainers review it.

recommendation.title: Adopt Or Review The Fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the external patch against current main and adopt it if it still fits the shared helper boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest feature-history signal for the shared bootstrap report helper and `/context` integration.
